name: wds_renderedsst2
description: A vision benchmark consisting of rendered SST-2 sentiment examples (text rendered as images) used to evaluate visual models' ability to read and classify sentiment from images of text. It tests robustness of vision and vision-language models to OCR-like inputs and the preservation of sentiment cues when text is presented visually.
reputation: Part of the CLIP-benchmark collection; moderately used for evaluating OCR-like and text-in-image robustness in vision-language research.
